task_prompt: Solve a 0/1 knapsack (values [12, 3, 9, 10, 9, 4], weights [3, 7, 5, 4, 6, 2], capacity 10) by building a penalized QUBO in dimod (slack-variable encoding for the capacity constraint) and sampling with SimulatedAnnealingSampler. Compare to brute force. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
